story_type: fishing boat on fire far offshore, crew in a life raft, helicopter hoists all five
hook: 85 miles out, their fishing boat was on fire.
narration: Eighty five miles out in the Atlantic, their fishing boat was on fire.
Five fishermen had been aboard the Nobska. Now an orange life raft sat right beside the flames.
Smoke kept pouring off the hull as a Coast Guard Jayhawk from Air Station Cape Cod arrived.
A hovering Jayhawk throws so much rotor wash that the sea goes white beneath it, and the rescue swimmer works inside that spray.
One by one, the crew brought all five fishermen up into the helicopter.
Behind them, the Nobska was still smoking.
outcome: The Cape Cod aircrew flew all five fishermen back to shore, and no injuries were reported.

location_card.place: 85 miles east of Cape Cod, Mass.

title: Fishing boat ablaze 85 miles out
description:
On April 30, 2021, a Coast Guard Air Station Cape Cod MH-60 Jayhawk aircrew rescued five fishermen after their commercial fishing vessel Nobska caught fire about 85 miles east of Cape Cod, Massachusetts. No injuries were reported.
